pages.title: Compare Sutra, Readest and Panels | Books, Comics and Personal Libraries
pages.description: Choose a reader for your own books and comics. Compare Sutra, Readest and Panels on platforms, pricing, privacy and personal-library access.
pages.heading: Your books. Your comics. Your choice.
pages.intro: Which reader fits your needs? Compare Sutra, Readest and Panels around your collection, devices, privacy preferences and budget. There is no single best reader for every library.
fit_summary: For mobile ebooks and guided comics together, direct personal-library connections, no app analytics and an optional one-time Pro upgrade.
For reading across mobile, desktop and web, with cloud library and annotation synchronization. Free and paid options have different limits [R1].
For an Apple-focused comic library, including CBR support and Mac reading. Subscription and current-major-version purchase options are available [P1].
pages.lead_title: A broad reader with a one-time Pro upgrade
pages.lead: Read EPUB and PDF for free. Full CBZ comics and DRM-free MOBI unlock with Sutra Pro, a one-time purchase per platform. Supported ZIP comic archives fit the same comic-reading workflow; ZIP is not a promise to open arbitrary files. Your source library can stay on a personal server, and Sutra adds no analytics or tracking.
benefits: Start large comics without the full download

With Sutra Pro, stream comic pages on demand from supported Kavita and Komga servers without downloading the whole archive first. Individual pages still transfer and may be cached; download the complete book for offline reading. Komga requires Page Streaming permission.
Connect the library you already have
Kavita, Komga, Calibre Content Server, Calibre-Web, Calibre-Web-Automated and compatible OPDS catalogs. Grimmory and Booklore can be used where they expose a compatible, reachable OPDS feed.
Read comics on a phone
Sutra's custom panel detection engine lets you move through comics one panel at a time. Lanczos-3 image resampling is available on iOS and Android for crisp rendering.
Keep your reading personal
No app analytics or tracking, and Sutra does not share your personal information. A server or cloud service you choose receives the information needed for that connection or sync feature.

pages.table_note: This is a decision guide based on published sources and owner-confirmed Sutra capabilities. It is not an independent review or a performance benchmark. A feature we have not verified is not a feature proved absent.
pages.choose_title: Choose around the way you actually read
pages.choose: Choose Sutra when your priorities are mobile books and comics, your own libraries, privacy and a one-time Pro purchase. Read the detailed comparisons if desktop reading, cloud synchronization or an Apple-only comic collection matters more to you.
pages.caveat: Current Komga connections still require Pro. Free Komga access is planned; full CBZ, future CBR and DRM-free MOBI remain Pro. General OPDS support means catalog access, not automatic streaming or server progress sync.

pages.title: Sutra vs Readest | Personal Libraries, Comics, Privacy and Price
pages.description: Compare Sutra and Readest for mobile books and comics, personal-library access, pricing, privacy and cross-device reading. See where each fits.
pages.heading: When your books and comics belong together.
pages.intro: Choosing between Sutra and Readest? Start with where you read, how you access your library and which sync features you need. Both offer free reading and optional paid features; the right fit depends on your workflow.
fit_summary: For ebooks and panel-by-panel comics on iOS and Android, supported personal servers, no app analytics and an optional one-time Pro purchase.
For desktop and web reading alongside mobile, cloud annotation sync and Read Aloud available today. Features and limits depend on the plan [R1].
pages.lead_title: Choose Sutra for a mobile library of books and comics
pages.lead: Read an EPUB, open a PDF, then move through a comic panel by panel on your phone. Sutra combines these reading styles with direct access to supported personal libraries on iOS and Android. EPUB and PDF stay free; full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI require Pro. Supported ZIP comic archives use the comic workflow.
benefits: Start large comics without the full download

With Sutra Pro, stream comic pages on demand from supported Kavita and Komga servers without downloading the whole archive first. Individual pages still transfer and may be cached; download the complete book for offline reading. Komga requires Page Streaming permission. Readest also documents streaming for compatible OPDS-PSE catalogs [R3]; streaming is not exclusive to Sutra.
A comic reader built for small screens

Sutra's custom panel detection lets you navigate comics one panel at a time. Lanczos-3 image resampling is available on both platforms. No comparative panel-detection or rendering benchmark is claimed.
Connect your personal collection

Use Kavita, Komga, Calibre Content Server, Calibre-Web, Calibre-Web-Automated, WebDAV and compatible OPDS catalogs. A compatible OPDS feed from Grimmory or Booklore is catalog access; sync depends on separate capabilities.
No app analytics
Sutra adds no analytics or tracking and does not share personal information. Readest documents optional anonymous aggregated telemetry, off by default for new installs [R2].

pages.table_note: Readest does not require a subscription for ordinary reading. A one-time Readest pack does not include all subscription services. Prices and entitlements should be checked for your storefront and needs. Sources checked November 21, 2026.
pages.choose_title: When Readest may fit you better
pages.choose: Readest is worth considering if you want desktop and browser reading, translation, or a cloud library with highlights and notes across platforms. Sutra's KOSync is still in development and covers progress rather than annotation sync. Choose based on the features available today, rather than future plans.
pages.caveat: Sutra does not currently support CBR or DRM-protected books. CBR/RAR support is in active development. Komga remains Pro until the planned free-access change ships. We have not run a hands-on comparison of both apps with the same library.

pages.title: Sutra vs Panels | Ebooks, Guided Comics and Android Reading
pages.description: Compare Sutra and Panels for books and comics, phone-friendly guided reading, personal libraries, privacy, platforms and one-time purchase options.
pages.heading: For the books between your comics, too.
pages.intro: Choosing between Sutra and Panels? Compare a mixed ebook-and-comic library with a comic-focused Apple workflow. Your file formats and devices matter more than an overall winner.
fit_summary: For text EPUB books, PDFs and guided comics in the same mobile app, Android as well as iOS, and no app analytics.
For a comic-focused Apple library, CBR files available today and reading on a Mac as well as iPhone and iPad [P1].
pages.lead_title: One mobile reader across reading styles
pages.lead: Sutra combines reflowable EPUB books and DRM-free MOBI with PDFs and CBZ or supported ZIP comics. Its custom panel detection engine lets you navigate comics one panel at a time on your phone. EPUB/PDF are free, and full CBZ and MOBI reading use a one-time Pro upgrade.
benefits: Start large comics without the full download

With Sutra Pro, stream comic pages on demand from supported Kavita and Komga servers without downloading the whole archive first. Individual pages still transfer and may be cached; download the complete book for offline reading. Komga requires Page Streaming permission. This describes Sutra's workflow, not an exclusive feature or a measured speed advantage over Panels.
Take the same app across mobile platforms
Sutra runs on iOS and Android. Pro purchases are separate for Apple and Google; using the same app does not imply that your entire library or annotations automatically sync across platforms.
Keep a mixed personal library
Connect Kavita, Komga, Calibre-family servers, WebDAV or compatible OPDS catalogs. Read novels and comics in the same app rather than choosing solely around comic formats.
Private reading with crisp rendering

Sutra has no app analytics or tracking and does not share personal information. Lanczos-3 rendering is shipped on both platforms. Duo facing-page reading is available; broader iPad and tablet spread work is in development.
rows: Comics, PDF and image EPUB; not text ebooks [P1]
Kavita/Komga and compatible OPDS; capabilities vary
pages.table_note: Panels has a one-time purchase option as well as subscriptions. Its listing says the one-time purchase unlocks the current major version's features. App Store privacy disclosures are supplied by the developer, not independently verified by Apple. Checked November 21, 2026.
pages.choose_title: When Panels may fit you better
pages.choose: If your collection is mainly comics and you need CBR today or a Mac reader, Panels may fit better. Guided reading and OPDS are shared capabilities, not Sutra exclusives. This comparison explains product fit; we have not established that Sutra detects panels more accurately or renders pages better.
pages.caveat: Sutra's CBR, wider tablet spreads, Kokoro Read Aloud and KOSync are development work. They should not be counted as available reasons to switch today. Current Komga access is Pro; making the connection free is planned separately.
pages.proof_title: A small screen can still suit a big comic
pages.proof: Watch Sutra's existing panel-reading demonstration. Full CBZ reading requires Pro; compare the experience with your own authorized files and the devices you use.
